I had a glass of beer--draft. I thought alcohol was supposed to inhibit your senses, and yet I feel so alone. The AC blowing in front of me, my skin cold to the touch. I can only look outside the window. There is a church across my house. I cannot even be sinful in my own home, not when the father and the son are staring at me, watching as I pour myself another glass, watching as I lay motionless---my eyes staring back at them. I am so tired and lonely. I feel almost weightless---I can see myself crawl out the window and fly---unfortunately the AC is there---I drink until I pass out. This is a normal Wednesday. 

*- Japanese Beer* 

My heart wants to come out—there is a tight knot in my throat and my finger runs over the edges of my saint—Mother. The edges are sharp and I use it to dull my feeling of nausea—-press harder—-more—-feel the pain—--don’t throw up. I can practically hear my heart racing, my muscles all tightening, not aware of the danger—there is none—and yet my body prepares. 

My head hurts again, the dull pain is back. Everything is suddenly back. I can feel every ailment cursed upon this body of mine, the scrapes on my knees from learning how to ride a bike, the burns caused by a glue gun, and the tearing of my muscles caused by sinning on Earth—--I was gifted these pains for being born. 

*my sister went to the hospital and now I fear everything; she is well now, but I do not like being reminded about what I could lose*
